Checking a Kenyan estate agent? Start with the 2026 Gazette

The published register is a place to start. Here’s how to use it alongside a current status check and a written mandate.

21 November 2026 · Kenya

Related event: 2026 register

Why it matters

The Estate Agents Registration Board’s 2026 Gazette publication gives you a reference for the names covered by that edition. It cannot tell you whether an agent’s status has changed since publication or whether they represent the owner of a specific property.

What to do next

Ask for the agent’s full practising name and registration details. Match those details against the published record, check current status directly with EARB and have your independent advocate check the agent’s written authority for the property.

Original source: Estate Agents Registration Board
